# diagrams

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-001 — A writer reads and inserts Mermaid diagrams that follow the theme](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-001.md) — When a writer previews a document with a Mermaid fence or directive, or picks Mermaid in the edition palette or the slash menu, the Studio SHALL draw the diagram as a picture sized to the content width in the colours of the preview theme, keep its source available, show a message with the parser reason on demand when the syntax is invalid, and insert a starter flowchart fence that renders at once.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-002 — Mermaid diagrams follow the preview theme](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-002.md) — When a writer switches the preview theme, the Studio SHALL draw Mermaid diagrams again in the colours of that theme and stay readable when theme colours are unavailable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-003 — Mermaid diagrams stay in place while typing](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-003.md) — When the preview content changes, the Studio SHALL keep unchanged Mermaid diagrams drawn and draw only new or changed ones.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-004 — Understand why a Mermaid diagram failed](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-004.md) — When a Mermaid diagram has invalid syntax, the Studio SHALL show one visible message with the parser reason on demand and keep the source readable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-005 — Insert a Mermaid diagram from the edit tools](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-005.md) — When a writer picks Mermaid in the edition palette or the slash menu, the Studio SHALL insert a starter flowchart fence that renders at once.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-006 — A writer reads PlantUML diagrams without any setup](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-006.md) — When a writer previews a document with a PlantUML fence or directive, the Studio SHALL draw it with the bundled engine, in the preview colours, without Java or network, and show a message that names the cause and the JAR option and keep the source readable when the bundled engine cannot draw it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-007 — A writer renders PlantUML with an own JAR or command, safely bounded](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-007.md) — When a writer sets the PlantUML options, the Studio SHALL draw with the bundled engine by default, or with the writer's own Java JAR or PlantUML command only when the JAR option is on and the workspace is trusted, name the cause on the diagram when that rendering is blocked or fails, and stop a diagram that is too large, too slow, too chatty or cancelled.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-008 — Understand why a bundled PlantUML diagram is not drawn](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-008.md) — When a writer previews a diagram the bundled engine cannot draw, the Studio SHALL show a message that names the cause and the JAR option, and keep the source readable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-009 — PlantUML diagrams use local include files and PUML files](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-009.md) — When a bundled-engine diagram includes local files or a document references a PlantUML file with the uml or plantuml directive, the Studio SHALL read them under the workspace rules, draw the assembled diagram, redraw it when the files change, stop at fixed limits and explain why a file cannot be read.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-010 — Keep PlantUML pictures in place while typing](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-010.md) — When the preview content or theme changes, the Studio SHALL redraw only the bundled-engine diagrams that need it and reuse the others.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-011 — Preview a diagram stored in a PUML file](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-011.md) — When a writer references a PlantUML file with the uml or plantuml directive, the Studio SHALL draw that file's diagram, follow its changes, and explain why a file cannot be read.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-012 — Render PlantUML with my own JAR or command](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-012.md) — When the JAR option is on in a trusted workspace, the Studio SHALL draw each PlantUML diagram with the configured JAR or the plantuml command and show the result in the open preview.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-013 — Understand why a JAR-rendered diagram failed or was blocked](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-013.md) — When a writer previews a PlantUML diagram whose JAR rendering is blocked or fails, the Studio SHALL show a message naming the cause on the diagram, and never start a process in an untrusted workspace.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-014 — A runaway PlantUML process cannot hang the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-DIAG-014.md) — When a JAR-rendered diagram is too large, too slow, too chatty or cancelled, the Studio SHALL stop it and report the reason.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
